unit_classes.name: Infantry
unit_classes.blurb: Close-order foot with blade and shield — the line that takes ground and holds it.

unit_classes.name: Spearmen
unit_classes.blurb: Foot soldiers behind long spears, steadiest of all against a cavalry charge.

unit_classes.name: Pikemen
unit_classes.blurb: A deep phalanx of pikes: nearly unbreakable head-on, slow to wheel and turn.

unit_classes.name: Missile troops
unit_classes.blurb: Bows, slings and javelins that thin the enemy line before the armies meet.

unit_classes.name: Cavalry
unit_classes.blurb: Riders for the charge, the flank, and the ruthless pursuit of the broken.

unit_classes.name: Horse archers
unit_classes.blurb: Mounted bowmen who sting, scatter, and are gone before a blow can land.

unit_classes.name: Chariots
unit_classes.blurb: War-cars that shock loose formations and terrify troops who have never faced them.

unit_classes.name: War elephants
unit_classes.blurb: Living siege towers that crush ranks; horses will not stand near them.

unit_classes.name: Siege engines
unit_classes.blurb: Rams, towers and engines for tearing down walls from a distance.

unit_classes.name: Warships
unit_classes.blurb: Hulls and crews that carry armies and hold the sea lanes.

unit_classes.name: Bodyguard
unit_classes.blurb: The general's own household guard: picked men around the standard.

unit_classes.name: Levies
unit_classes.blurb: Farm folk pressed into a battle line — many hands, little heart for it.

attributes.name: Phalanx
attributes.blurb: Forms a bristling wall of spearpoints, near impenetrable from the front and helpless when flanked.

attributes.name: Testudo
attributes.blurb: Locks shields overhead against arrows while closing on walls.

attributes.name: Shield wall
attributes.blurb: A locked line of shields that blunts the force of a charge.

attributes.name: War cry
attributes.blurb: A roar before contact that shakes the nerve of green defenders.

attributes.name: Frightens horses
attributes.blurb: Horses shy from their smell and noise; enemy cavalry loses its nerve nearby.

attributes.name: Frightens foot
attributes.blurb: Their onset unsettles enemy foot soldiers before the lines even touch.

attributes.name: Forest ambusher
attributes.blurb: Can lie hidden among trees until the moment to strike.

attributes.name: Sapper
attributes.blurb: Can undermine enemy walls during a siege.

attributes.name: Fleet-footed
attributes.blurb: Covers ground on the battlefield faster than most.

attributes.name: Hardy
attributes.blurb: Tires slowly, marching and fighting long after others flag.

effects.name: Law
effects.blurb: Public order from authority and justice.

effects.name: Happiness
effects.blurb: Public order from contentment: games, gods and comforts.

effects.name: Growth
effects.blurb: Population increase in the settlement each turn.

effects.name: Health
effects.blurb: Cleanliness that holds back squalor and plague.

effects.name: Trade
effects.blurb: Percent increase to the settlement's trade income.

effects.name: Farm income
effects.blurb: Denarii from the fields each turn.

effects.name: Mine income
effects.blurb: Denarii from the diggings each turn.

effects.name: Recruit training
effects.blurb: New units muster already drilled, with starting experience.

effects.name: Weapon upgrades
effects.blurb: Sharper arms for every unit trained here.

effects.name: Armor upgrades
effects.blurb: Heavier protection for every unit trained here.

effects.name: Walls
effects.blurb: The settlement's fortification tier — attackers pay for it in blood and seasons.

effects.name: Roads
effects.blurb: The region's roads: armies march farther and trade moves freer.

effects.name: Port
effects.blurb: The harbor's tier: sea trade and the slips that lay down fleets.

effects.name: Civic Benefit
effects.blurb: Public good the city can see delivered, which is what makes rule feel legitimate. Entertainment carries a negative value: spectacle placates, it does not legitimate.

effects.name: Burden
effects.blurb: What a building costs the people living under it. Burden adds to the load a province is made to bear, and grievance is what the load leaves behind.

effects.name: Coercion
effects.blurb: Order bought with force rather than consent. It works, it keeps working, and a people already turned toward arms enforces it harder.

effects.name: Assimilation
effects.blurb: How strongly your own stonework draws a foreign people toward counting itself among yours.

effects.name: Martial Character
effects.blurb: How far a building turns a people toward arms — the halls and grounds that make soldiering look like the natural life.

effects.name: Craft
effects.blurb: What a building teaches and keeps alive. Craft is a practice, not a possession: it decays in any year nobody works at it.

building_kinds.name: Government
building_kinds.blurb: The seat of rule. Its tier is the settlement's tier: no city outgrows its hall.

building_kinds.name: Walls
building_kinds.blurb: Fortifications that turn a town into a fastness.

building_kinds.name: Barracks
building_kinds.blurb: Drills the line: infantry, spearmen and pikemen.

building_kinds.name: Stables
building_kinds.blurb: Raises the mounted arm: cavalry, horse archers, chariots and elephants.

building_kinds.name: Archery range
building_kinds.blurb: Trains the skirmish screen: archers, slingers and javelinmen.

building_kinds.name: Shipwright
building_kinds.blurb: Lays down the warships that carry armies and close the sea lanes.

building_kinds.name: Siege workshop
building_kinds.blurb: Builds the rams and engines that open walled cities.

building_kinds.name: Temple
building_kinds.blurb: A god's house: devotion for the people, and for some gods, sacred warriors.

building_kinds.name: Farms
building_kinds.blurb: Feeds the settlement's growth and yields farm income.

building_kinds.name: Market
building_kinds.blurb: The bustle of commerce: trade income for the treasury.

building_kinds.name: Mines
building_kinds.blurb: Ore and coin dug from beneath the hills.

building_kinds.name: Port
building_kinds.blurb: Quays and warehouses that open the settlement to the sea.

building_kinds.name: Roads
building_kinds.blurb: Cut ways through the region: armies march farther, goods move freer.

building_kinds.name: Health
building_kinds.blurb: Baths and drains that hold back squalor and plague.

building_kinds.name: Entertainment
building_kinds.blurb: Spectacle and games that keep the people content.

building_kinds.name: Education
building_kinds.blurb: Academies that sharpen the men who govern.

building_kinds.name: Execution grounds
building_kinds.blurb: Grim justice in public view: order through fear.
